dedupe_keys.name: remondis contamination dataset rcd collection truck camera images of plastic bag contamination in bins

description: This image collection shows what cameras on rubbish trucks see as bins are tipped, with plastic bags marked wherever they contaminate recycling or organics loads. The producers are Umair Iqbal and Tim Davies of the SMART Infrastructure Facility at the University of Wollongong, Johan Barthelemy, now at NVIDIA, and Pascal Perez of AURIN, who curated it from historical footage of the waste company Remondis and from open sources. Coverage is 1,125 images of bins and truck hoppers in varied light, zoom and angles, with 1,851 labelled plastic bags such as supermarket carrier bags and black bin liners; the bag brands point to Australian collection routes. Images and bounding box labels in KITTI format, split into training and validation sets, are available as a free download from Zenodo under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: one contaminant type, small images, some images from online sources, not trucks, and no dates or locations. Simulation uses: training on-truck detectors that flag contaminated bins, which feeds route-level contamination rates into models of recycling quality and processing plant load. Related records: the PlastiCircle pilots (data-plasticircle-packaging-waste-pilots) measure packaging collection quality.
name: Remondis Contamination Dataset (RCD): collection-truck camera images of plastic-bag contamination in bins
provider: Umair Iqbal and Tim Davies (SMART Infrastructure Facility, University of Wollongong), Johan Barthelemy (NVIDIA) and Pascal Perez (AURIN), with Remondis
schema_summary: 1,125 RGB images (640 x 480; 968 training, 157 validation) from cameras on waste collection trucks and open sources, showing bins and truck hoppers; 1,851 bounding boxes of plastic-bag contaminants (supermarket, coloured, white, black bags and packaging) in KITTI format

sources.note: Creators Iqbal, Davies (SMART Infrastructure Facility), Barthelemy (NVIDIA), Perez (AURIN); CC BY 4.0; published 2023-08-15; one zip (400 MB); images curated from historical records of Remondis and open online sources, captured by cameras on waste collection trucks (bins, hoppers, varied zoom, angle, lighting); 1,125 JPEG images 640x480, 968 train/157 validation; 1,851 bounding boxes in KITTI format; contaminants include Coles bags, Woolworths bags, colour, white and black bags and packaging
